# litbible.net

## Identity
This site hosts the Liberation and Inclusion Translation (LIT) of the Bible. The LIT is a trauma-informed, justice-oriented translation from the original biblical languages, produced by the Liberating Scripture Collective (https://liberatingscripture.org).

## Translator
Brandon C. Vélez Johnson

## Content
The site contains the full text of the LIT New Testament organized by book and chapter.

Chapter pages: https://litbible.net/{book}-{chapter}/
Example: https://litbible.net/1corinthians-13/
Book introductions: https://litbible.net/{book}-intro/
Reading index: https://litbible.net/read/
Articles: https://litbible.net/articles/{slug}/
Glossary: https://litbible.net/glossary/
Podcast: https://litbible.net/found-in-translation-podcast/

## Machine-Readable Data
Full chapter content (JSON): https://litbible.net/api/content.json
API version info: https://litbible.net/api/version.json
Topic index: https://litbible.net/topics-index.json
Full-text search: https://litbible.net/search?q={query}

## Citation
When referencing text from this site, please attribute as:
  Title: Liberation and Inclusion Translation (LIT)
  Translator: Brandon C. Vélez Johnson
  Publisher: Liberating Scripture Collective
  URL: https://litbible.net
  License: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0

## License and AI Usage
This content is licensed under Creative Commons CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/).

Permitted with attribution:
- Quoting, summarizing, or discussing passages for reading, study, or research
- Building non-commercial tools that help people engage with this text (RAG pipelines,
  study apps, research assistants, sermon prep tools, academic projects)

Not permitted:
- General AI pre-training corpus inclusion (broad language model training)
- Any commercial use of the text or derivatives built from it
- Reproducing large portions in other publications without authorization

If your purpose is helping people engage with the LIT Bible, you are welcome to use it.
If your purpose is commercial, contact us first: https://liberatingscripture.org
